title: Reagan UFO briefing attended by James Baker
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Reagan UFO briefing attended by James Baker, about 1980s at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And James Baker is also a member of the family, and he's involved in a UFO breach briefing according to Nick Redfern. So, he's invited into a briefing that Reagan gets where a bunch of people come in. One's from CIA S&T, which is presumably Kit Green and his people. You got the Collins Elite who come in, and then there's another group who who do a briefing as well.
